features.name: Expanding wild reels
features.description: Horsemen grow into full reels in the bonus.

review:
The Four Horsemen ride reels 2 to 5, each as its own wild multiplier: Pestilence on reel 2 (2x–4x), War on reel 3 (5x–9x), then Famine and Death with bigger values on reels 4 and 5. Several in one win add together.

In the bonus rounds, the horsemen become expanding wild reels, so a full line-up can light up the middle of the grid. Because each one lives on its own reel, you always know what a spin is building towards. 15,000x max.
